title: Formal comparison for flat valuation algebras in height one
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed], $V\subseteq K$ a nontrivial height-one valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring], and $0\ne\pi\in\mathfrak m_V$. A hat denotes $\pi$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Put $\widehat K=\widehat V[1/\pi]$. Then $\widehat K$ is an algebraically closed complete rank-one valued field, with valuation ring $\widehat V$. Let $A$ be a flat finitely presented $V$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] with geometrically reduced $A_K=A\otimes_VK$. Then $\widehat A$ is flat and topologically finitely presented over $\widehat V$, and $C=\widehat A[1/\pi]$ is a reduced affinoid $\widehat K$-algebra; the image of $\widehat A$ in $C$ is bounded and topologically finitely generated over $\widehat V$. For every flat finitely presented $V$-algebra $E$ and every $0\ne s\in V$, the inverse image of $s\widehat E$ under $E\to\widehat E$ is $sE$. Finally, if $A\subseteq E\subseteq A_K$, $E$ is finite over $A$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], finitely presented as an $A$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], and flat finitely presented over $V$, then the canonical map $\widehat A\otimes_AE\to\widehat E$ is an isomorphism and the inclusion $E\subseteq A_K$ induces an injective map $\widehat E\to C$ with $\widehat E[1/\pi]\cong C$. The completion maps $A\to\widehat A$ and $E\to\widehat E$ are not asserted to be injective; zero completions are included.
